## Public information

Follow the [public information rules](../CONTRIBUTING.md#public-information).

- [ ] No private repository names, internal project names, hostnames, LAN addresses, or SSIDs.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures use synthetic values, including RFC 5737 addresses and synthetic GitHub organizations, repositories, and tokens.
- [ ] No real organization or repository configuration, tokens, state, or saved plans.
- [ ] No per-device update or verification history.
- [ ] Supported and tested versions are documented separately from any per-device history.
